title: Deep learning analysis of sinus-rhythm echocardiography for the identification of patients with atrial fibrillation
summary: In 85,686 retrospective TTE studies, the model achieved AUC 0.85 on an independent test set and model-positive classification among patients without prior AF was associated with subsequent documented AF (adjusted HR 1.64) and adverse outcomes (adjusted HR 1.24). Independent 20% patient-level holdout test and longitudinal outcomes; single tertiary-center retrospective cohort, routine documentation may miss AF, and authors call for external/prospective validation. No exact matching result in frozen active or archived catalogs.
ai_technology: A deep neural network analyzes apical four-chamber and parasternal long-axis echocardiography videos acquired in sinus rhythm to identify AF-associated imaging signals.
organization: Leviev Cardiovascular Institute, Sheba Medical Center, Ramat Gan, Israel; Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences, Tel Aviv University, Tel Aviv, Israel; Aisap.ai, Ramat Gan, Israel
